chunks.head: at length
chunks.note: at length = (经过一段时间后)最终、终于;另义"详尽地"。

literal.note_cn: 此处引申"经过长时间之后"

chunks.ex_en: At length the rain stopped and we went outside.
chunks.ex_cn: 终于雨停了,我们走到了外面。

chunks.head: a great deal of
chunks.note: 修饰不可数名词,= a lot of。

literal.note_cn: 此处名词"数量",非"交易/发牌"义

chunks.ex_en: She spent a great deal of money on books.

chunks.head: take care of
chunks.ex_en: She takes care of her little brother after school.
chunks.ex_cn: 放学后她照顾她的弟弟。

chunks.head: on the contrary
chunks.note: 用来否定前句、引出相反的事实。
chunks.ex_en: I'm not tired; on the contrary, I feel great.
chunks.ex_cn: 我不累;相反,我感觉很好。

chunks.head: lay up
chunks.note: lay up = 把(东西)存起来、囤积起来。
chunks.ex_en: They laid up food for the long winter.
chunks.ex_cn: 他们为漫长的冬天储存食物。

chunks.head: that is to say
chunks.note: 用于对前面内容作进一步解释。
chunks.ex_en: He left last Friday, that is to say, three days ago.
chunks.ex_cn: 他上周五走的,也就是三天前。

chunks.head: leave off
chunks.note: leave off (doing) = 停下来、不再做。
chunks.ex_en: We left off our game when it got dark.
chunks.ex_cn: 天黑了,我们就停下了游戏。

chunks.head: spare no pains
chunks.note: spare no pains = 不惜辛劳、竭尽全力。

literal.note_cn: 复数表"努力、功夫",非"疼痛"

chunks.ex_en: The teacher spared no pains to help us pass.
chunks.ex_cn: 老师不遗余力地帮我们通过。

chunks.head: on shore
chunks.note: on shore = 在陆地上/上岸(与在船上、海上相对)。
chunks.ex_en: After weeks at sea, the sailors were glad to be on shore.
chunks.ex_cn: 在海上漂了几周后,水手们很高兴上了岸。

chunks.head: carry away
chunks.ex_en: The thieves carried away everything of value.
chunks.ex_cn: 小偷把值钱的东西都拿走了。

chunks.head: cut off from
chunks.note: be cut off from = 与…隔绝、断了联系。
chunks.ex_en: The island was completely cut off from the mainland.
chunks.ex_cn: 那座岛与大陆完全隔绝了。

chunks.head: on the other hand
chunks.note: 引出对比或另一面的观点。
chunks.ex_en: It's cheaper to cook at home; on the other hand, it takes more time.
chunks.ex_cn: 在家做饭更便宜;另一方面,更费时间。

chunks.head: by no means
chunks.note: 强调否定,= not at all。
chunks.ex_en: The job is by no means easy.

chunks.head: take courage
chunks.ex_en: Take courage and tell her the truth.
chunks.ex_cn: 鼓起勇气,把真相告诉她。

chunks.head: now and then
chunks.note: (every) now and then = 偶尔、不时。
chunks.ex_en: We still meet now and then for coffee.
chunks.ex_cn: 我们仍时不时聚在一起喝咖啡。

chunks.head: in order to
chunks.ex_en: He got up early in order to catch the train.

chunks.head: meet with
chunks.note: meet with = 遇到、经历(常指困难、事件、反应)。
chunks.ex_en: The plan met with strong opposition.
chunks.ex_cn: 这个计划遭到了强烈反对。

chunks.head: at a loss
chunks.note: 本章出处为分离式(at a strange loss),故 card-only;at a loss = 茫然、不知怎么办。

literal.note_cn: 此处"茫然、不知所措",非"损失、失去"

chunks.ex_en: She was at a loss for words.
chunks.ex_cn: 她一时语塞,不知说什么好。
